mapper.sql: select inv.id as id, inv.game_id as game_id, inv.region_id as region_id, r.name as region_name, inv.item_id as item_id, item.name as item_name, item.code as item_code, item.image as item_image, inv.stock as stock, inv.purchase_price as purchase_price, inv.max_fluctuation as max_fluctuation, inv.max_fluctuation_rate as max_fluctuation_rate, inv.is_active as is_active, inv.created_at as created_at, inv.updated_at as updated_at from game_region_inventory inv join game_items item on inv.item_id = item.id join game_regions r on inv.region_id = r.id where inv.is_active = 1 and item.is_active = 1 and (#{gameId} is null or inv.game_id = #{gameId}) and (#{regionId} is null or inv.region_id = #{regionId})
left join game_region_inventory_shop_price sp on sp.inventory_id = inv.id and sp.account_id = #{accountId} and sp.is_active = 1
